name: Mixed-Media Studio
why: A before/after pitch told as a tour through the worlds an edit passes through (camera, timeline, chat, sketchbook, viewfinder, design tool, speaker, poster), each idea in its own world.
look: Every scene is a different medium, held together by one thread: Archivo Black for every headline, one hot red accent with a yellow highlight, and word-synced captions on a black plate. Hard cuts between worlds.
elements: NLE timeline with piling clips and a spinning clock
phone chat with a video bubble uploading
pencil sketchbook waveform cut with scissors
punch-in selection box with a zoom tag
design-tool artboard with LOCKED caption chips and popping logo tiles
phone speaker EQ: dim sub, glowing mids
motion: Snappy springs and scale pops on cues, hard cuts between worlds, a shake on every hit, pencil lines boiling on twos in the sketchbook.
